These vignettes collect R techniques gathered over the years. Each is a self-contained worked example; most use freely available oceanographic and Earth-system data.

## Ocean and Earth-system data

| Title | Description |
|----|----|
| [Global Earth and ocean data](../vignettes/gridded_data_intro.llms.md) | This vignette intorduces the variety gridded data products available freely on the internet. |
| [Dates from netCDF files: two approaches](../vignettes/netCDF_dates.llms.md) | This vignette demonstrates basic ideas behind dates in netCDF files. |
| [Retrieving chlorophyll-*a* data from ERDDAP servers](../vignettes/chl_ERDDAP.llms.md) | This vignette demonstrates basic ideas behind ERDDAP. |
| [Wget download from NASA Earthdata](../vignettes/download_earthdata.llms.md) |  |
| [Regridding gridded data](../vignettes/regridding.llms.md) | This vignette demonstrates basic ideas behind regridding. |
| [Extracting gridded data within a buffer](../vignettes/buffer_data_extract.llms.md) |  |
| [Wind stress curl](../vignettes/Wind_stress_curl.llms.md) | This vignette demonstrates the basic calculation of wind stress curl in R. |
